scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @chorusborn/server" "npm run dev -w @chorusborn/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @chorusborn/web
scripts.test:serve: concurrently --kill-others --names test-server,web "tsx tests/support/server.ts" "npm run dev -w @chorusborn/web -- --mode browser-test"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build -w @chorusborn/web
